msProducts.note: MiniShop3 keeps msProducts name; verify options (tpl, limit). Heal front remaps static_file if still pointing at minishop2.

msCart.note: Heal front rewrites cart-page chunks (tpl.msCart / #msCart): ms3_form, product_key, selector SSR.

msMiniCart.note: Heal front bridges to msCart; prefers customMiniCart tpl when present; wires #minicart-content.

msMiniCartDynamic.note: MS2-era AJAX minicart — Heal front stubs it; remove msminicartdynamic.js from layout.

msOrder.note: Checkout flow differs in ms3 — review template.

msGetOrder.note: Order page tpl may need ms3 classes.

msGallery.note: Full gallery widget in MS3 — listing cards should use [[+thumb]]/[[+image]] (Heal front swaps product-card embeds).

msProductOptions.note: Renamed/merged into msOptions in many ms3 setups.

tpl.msProducts.note: Rebuild product row chunks for ms3 markup.

tpl.msCart.note: Heal front rewrites MS2→MS3 cart markup + #msCart selector; verify theme-specific JS.

tpl.msMiniCart.note: Rebuild minicart chunk for ms3 or keep customMiniCart via Heal front bridge.

customMiniCart.note: Heal front updates ms2_form → ms3_form and lexicon keys when present.

productCard.note: Listing cards: prefer [[+thumb]] over [[msGallery]] after MS3.

attention_patterns.message: miniShop2 frontend JS detected — update theme scripts to MiniShop3 (ms3) cart API.
Form class ms2_form — Heal front remaps to ms3_form where safe; verify cart/order templates.
Legacy class_key/newQuery('msProduct') — Heal front rewrites to MiniShop3\Model\msProduct (fixes zero product counts).
Legacy miniShop2 class/key reference — verify after ms3 install.
msGallery used as product-card thumb — MS3 gallery is a full widget; Heal front swaps to [[+thumb]]/[[+image]].
modFileHandler (removed in MODX 3) — Heal front patches phpThumbOn::makeDir when package present.
